entity.name: Soundwave (Peachtree Group)
entity.address_line_1: 112 W Beach Blvd, Gulf Shores, AL 36542
entity.description: Perched above the shoreline, our beach bar in Gulf Shores brings together live music, coastal cocktails, and laid-back energy with unbeatable views. Whether you're here for sunset drinks, weekend bands, or a casual night out with friends, this is where the vibe turns up. Sip frozen favorites, signature craft cocktails, and local brews while the music sets the tone. From daytime chill to after-dark beats, every night feels like summer. Don't miss out on our open-air bar, 30 feet above the Gulf, offering stunning views, live music, and a state-of-the-art sound system. Enjoy craft cocktails, elevated bar bites, and a fun beach vibe.
